vibe: Cyberpunk Hacker Future, Underground Digital Market, L33t Aesthetics, Premium Black Market

typography.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-heading tracking-tighter uppercase
typography.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-heading tracking-tight uppercase

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Terminal density for admin, wide immersive asymmetry for store.

surfaces_and_effects.header: backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 border-b border-primary/20 sticky top-0 z-50
surfaces_and_effects.cards_store: bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-800 hover:border-primary/50 transition-colors duration-300 group
surfaces_and_effects.buttons_primary: bg-primary text-black font-mono uppercase tracking-widest px-6 py-3 hover:bg-primary_hover transition-all shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,255,163,0.3)]
surfaces_and_effects.buttons_secondary: bg-transparent border border-primary text-primary font-mono uppercase tracking-widest px-6 py-3 hover:bg-primary/10 transition-all

motion_and_interactions.hover_state: Slight lift (-translate-y-1), border illuminates to neon green or pink.
motion_and_interactions.special_effects: Use react-fast-marquee for an 'Editorial Ribbon' of hacker stats or categories at the footer or middle of the store front.

component_instructions.shadcn_overrides: Do not use rounded corners. Override all Shadcn primitives (Input, Button, Card, Table) with 'rounded-none'. Change primary colors in tailwind.config.js to map to #00FFA3.
component_instructions.charts: Use Recharts for the admin dashboard. Configure chart tooltips with dark background and neon green borders.
component_instructions.tables: Admin order and customer databases must use a dense, monospace font layout for headers to mimic a terminal system.
component_instructions.forms: Inputs should have bg-black, border-b border-zinc-700, focus:border-primary. No thick borders, minimal style.
component_instructions.checkout: Must include fake 'Payment processing...' terminal-style loading state. Use monospace font for payment total.

testing_requirements.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements, buttons, nav links, and form inputs MUST have data-testid attributes formatted in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='add-to-cart-button', data-testid='admin-login-submit').
